test_title: PYST 69: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question:
Read the following statements and mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): Subramaniya Siva edited the nationalist journal 'Gnanabhanu' in Tamil Nadu.

Reason (R): He was the first Indian to be arrested under the Rowlatt Act.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Subramaniya Siva was a prominent nationalist from Tamil Nadu and **edited the Tamil journal *Gnanabhanu*** to spread patriotic ideas.
 
• He actively participated in the **Swadeshi Movement** and worked closely with leaders like Subramania Bharati.
 
• The **Rowlatt Act (1919)** allowed arrest without trial, but **Subramaniya Siva was not the first person arrested under it**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Subramaniya Siva was imprisoned multiple times by the British and suffered from **leprosy due to harsh jail conditions**.
 
• His writings and speeches played an important role in **awakening nationalism in South India**.
